findings.title: A profile switch during combat turns preview on mid-fight, bypassing the combat refusal
findings.locations: modules/Preview.lua:198-204 (PROFILE handler); modules/Preview.lua:126 (NS.AcceptLock), :95; settings/Slash.lua:307; core/PartyFrameEnhanced.lua:302-311; modules/CastBars.lua:263
findings.evidence: PROFILE handler calls applyLock directly, skipping AcceptLock's InCombatLockdown refusal; PLAYER_REGEN_DISABLED re-lock has already fired. Cast bars show 'Preview cast' placeholders for the rest of the fight. Reachable via /pfe profile use or Profiles page in combat to a profile stored unlocked. No test covers it.
findings.remediation: C-001: in the PROFILE receiver, when locked==false and InCombatLockdown(), NS.SetByPath('locked', true) and print the combat re-lock line; else applyLock as today. Two new cases in tests/test_profile_switch.lua (455->457).

findings.title: One raising deferred secure write aborts the flush and orphans every later key for the session
findings.evidence: Flush calls each queued closure with no per-entry isolation; a raise stops the loop, later keys stay in pending but are gone from pendingOrder, and RunSecure never re-appends them, so in-combat writes for those keys are dropped until /reload; also skips NS.PublishVisibility(); diagnostics report pending=0. No known trigger today (candidates: SetPoint loop in Anchor.Apply, F-003).
findings.remediation: C-002: run each deferred write isolated (pcall), fully consume pending/pendingOrder regardless, log ungated to console and report via geterrorhandler(); add tests.

findings.title: unwrapFrame re-wraps another addon's handler without a guard, inside the secure queue
findings.evidence: SecureHandlerUnwrapScript is pcall'ed but the restoring SecureHandlerWrapScript is not; a raise exits unwrapAll (the 'follow:wrap' queued closure), stopping the unwrap pass and triggering F-002 in combat; the other addon's wrap is not restored. Only reachable with another addon wrapping the same frame's OnAttributeChanged after this one; nothing in the collection does.
findings.remediation: Wrap the re-wrap in its own pcall so the unwrap pass continues (Theme B).

findings.title: /pfe status prints 'unlocked' twice whenever the elements are unlocked
findings.evidence: Preview branch adds 'unlocked (stand-in)'/'unlocked (your party frames)', then Anchor.IsUnlocked adds 'unlocked'; applyLock sets both together, so output reads e.g. 'Note: unlocked (stand-in), unlocked'.
findings.remediation: Print one unlocked flag; the preview branch already names the view.

findings.title: /pfe profile new rebuilds everything twice and logs a no-op reset
findings.evidence: After the exists check, SetProfile always lands on an empty (default) profile; NS.ResetProfileCounted then fires OnProfileReset -> adoptProfile again: second PROFILE broadcast, VISIBILITY publish, panel refresh, and a '[Set] reset profile ... (0 rows)' line.
findings.remediation: Drop the redundant reset after SetProfile.
